points.concept: ध्वनि ऊर्जा का एक रूप है
points.point: Sound = form of energy; energy conservation applies; clap needs energy.
Production of sound = vibration of object; tuning fork activities prove it.

points.concept: कंपन के विभिन्न तरीके और वाक-तंतु
points.point: Many methods, one cause: vibration; vocal cords for speech; instrument parts vibrate.

points.concept: ध्वनि का संचरण – माध्यम और विक्षोभ
points.point: Medium required; disturbance travels; particles oscillate locally; mechanical wave.
Compression = high P/density; Rarefaction = low P/density; series forms sound wave.
Longitudinal: particle motion parallel to wave; sound is longitudinal.
Transverse = perpendicular particle motion; light transverse non-mechanical; sound longitudinal.

points.concept: ध्वनि तरंग के अभिलक्षण – आवृत्ति, आयाम, तारत्व
points.point: ν=1/T; pitch↔frequency; loudness↔amplitude; λ between successive C or R.
